BOOK ONE · LESSON 077

Terrible toothache

要命的牙痛

A dialogue lesson in which Mr. Croft visits the dentist's office with a terrible toothache and insists on seeing the doctor immediately, even though the nurse says the dentist is busy and suggests he wait till 2 p.m. or this afternoon. Mr. Croft's famous reply 'I can wait, but my toothache can't!' closes the lesson. Includes a fill-in dialogue practice, an appointment-time Q&A exercise, and grammar on past-tense fill-in-the-blank, question-and-answer formation from sentences, and 'must ... I want to ...' sentence construction.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question.
What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?
听录音，然后回答问题。你认为现在是几点钟？你怎么知道的？

Listen to the recording, then answer: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?

  1. 1

    NURSE

    Good morning, Mr. Croft.

    护士：早上好，克罗夫特先生。

  2. 2

    MR. CROFT

    Good morning, nurse.
    I want to see the dentist, please.

    克罗夫特先生：早上好，护士。我想见牙科医生。

  3. 3

    NURSE

    Do you have an appointment?

    护士：您约好了吗？

  4. 4

    MR. CROFT

    No, I don't.

    克罗夫特先生：没有。

  5. 5

    NURSE

    Is it urgent?

    护士：急吗？

  6. 6

    MR. CROFT

    Yes, it is.
    It's very urgent.
    I feel awful.
    I have a terrible toothache.

    克罗夫特先生：是的，很急。我难受极了，牙痛得要命。

  7. 7

    NURSE

    Can you come at 10 a.m.
    on Monday, April 24th?

    护士：您在4月24日星期一上午10点钟来可以吗？

  8. 8

    MR. CROFT

    I must see the dentist now, nurse.

    克罗夫特先生：我必须现在就见牙科医生，护士。

  9. 9

    NURSE

    The dentist is very busy
    at the moment.
    Can you come at 2 p.m.?

    护士：牙科医生这会儿很忙。您下午两点钟来行吗？

  10. 10

    MR. CROFT

    That's very late.
    Can the dentist see me now?

    克罗夫特先生：那就太晚了。牙科医生现在能给我看一下吗？

  11. 11

    NURSE

    I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
    Can't you wait till this afternoon?

    护士：恐怕不能，克罗夫特先生。您就不能等到今天下午吗？

  12. 12

    MR. CROFT

    I can wait, but my toothache can't!

    克罗夫特先生：我倒可以等。可是我的牙痛等不了啊！

Listening — answer the question

Listen then answer this question. What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know? 听录音，然后回答问题。你认为现在是几点钟？你怎么知道的？

Answer the question according to the dialogue.

New words & expressions 生词和短语

appointment /əˈpɔɪntmənt/
n. 约会，预约
urgent /ˈɜːdʒənt/
adj. 紧急的，急迫的
till /tɪl/
prep. 直到……为止

Notes on the text 课文注释

Can't you wait till this afternoon?

这是情态动词的否定疑问句，表示请求。

a.m. / p.m.

a.m. 是"上午"，p.m. 是指"下午"。10 a.m.，上午10点，2 p.m.，下午两点。
